title: Serialize listener-heavy integration tests across the host
goal: Keep host-only and sealed peer-channel integration tests deterministic when the native gate runs test binaries concurrently, without weakening their network assertions.

results.why: The native gate runs integration binaries concurrently; listener-heavy tests could contend for daemon scheduling and the two peer-channel tests could select resources simultaneously.
results.change: Both binaries acquire a crash-safe OS file lock for their real-listener lifetime, shared through tests/common/mod.rs. Existing port probes, privacy assertions and sealed-channel assertions remain unchanged.

tests.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --test host_only_privacy --test peer_channel_hub: 4 passed, 0 failed
tests.concurrent_processes: host_only_privacy 2 passed, 0 failed; peer_channel_hub 2 passed, 0 failed
tests.native_gate: cargo local-workflow check: format passed; strict clippy passed; 110/110 test binaries ran with 0 failed; doc-tests passed; total 54.8s
tests.diff: cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check passed

limitations: The lock coordinates Susi integration binaries that use it; unrelated user processes can still occupy a port and are handled by each test's existing bounded failure paths.
